# Avatar is at rows 24-29, aligned with blue block (25-28)
# Track has 8 white blocks. Let me check track extent
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']

w_blocks = []
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
        maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
        w_blocks.append((minc, maxc))
w_blocks.sort()

# Check colored blocks
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 50:
        b = n['boundary']
        minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
        maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
        print("Colored %s: rows %d-%d" % (n['color'], minr, maxr))

# Check avatar
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 50:
        b = n['boundary']
        print("Avatar: rows %d-%d" % (min(p[0] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b)))

# Check track
w_count = sum(1 for n in seg if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4)
print("White blocks:", w_count)

</function>
